tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Use when you need team codes, or all 32 current teams with conference, division, colours, and logo URLs. Team codes are nflverse spelling (LA for the Rams, WAS for Washington). Cheapest tool at 1 credit.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Use for regular-season standings and playoff seeding: record, win%, points for/against, home/away/division/conference records, streak, division rank, and conference seed. Ranks apply the real NFL tiebreaking procedure and report which step decided each one. Computed from final scores. Defaults to th

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Use for one team's season: totals (passing, rushing, receiving, defense, kicking, penalties), EPA per play, yards per attempt/carry, the standings row, and every weekly stat line. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Use when querying past or future games with filters: season, week, team, date range, game type, status. Returns scores, kickoff (UTC), venue, rest days, starting QBs, coaches, referee, and the consensus closing spread, total, and moneylines. For upcoming-only games prefer get_schedule (2 cr). Costs

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use to see what is coming up: unplayed games in the next N days (default 7), or a specific week of the current season. Includes consensus lines where posted. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_game_detail
tools.description: Use when you need everything about one game: both teams, full team box-score stats (EPA, success, drives), consensus closing line, per-bookmaker opening/closing/latest odds, weather, surface, and officials. Requires a game id from get_games or get_schedule. Costs 10 credits.

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Use to compare two teams' history: recent meetings with scores, the win/loss record between them, and average margin. Filter by season or get all-time. Costs 10 credits.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Use to find a player by name (partial match). Searches ~25,000 players back to 1999; returns current-season players by default, falling back to all players back to 1999 when none match. Returns the GSIS player id needed by get_player_stats. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: Use for one player: bio, draft, physicals, headshot, id crosswalk (PFR, ESPN), summed season totals across passing, rushing, receiving, defense, kicking, returns, and fantasy points, every weekly stat line for the season, and games played per season. Defaults to the player's latest season. Costs 5 c

tools.name: get_player_leaders
tools.description: Use to rank players on any weekly stat over a season: passing_yards, passing_tds, rushing_yards, receiving_yards, receptions, targets, def_sacks, def_interceptions, fantasy_points_ppr, passing_epa, rushing_epa, receiving_epa, and ~130 more. Counting stats are summed, rate stats averaged. Filter by p

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Use for the official injury report: game status (Out, Doubtful, Questionable) and practice participation with the injury named, by team and week. Defaults to the latest reported week of the current season. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_depth_chart
tools.description: Use for a team's depth chart by week: formation, position, depth rank, player. Defaults to the latest week available. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_snap_counts
tools.description: Use for playing time: offensive, defensive, and special-teams snaps and snap shares, for one game, one player (PFR id), or a team's season. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_plays
tools.description: Use for play-by-play with nflfastR metrics: EPA, WPA, win probability, success, CPOE, air yards, formation flags, and the players involved. Filter by game, or by season plus week/team/player, plus play type, down, quarter, win-probability band, red zone, third down. Set include_charting for FTN manu

tools.name: get_advanced_stats
tools.description: Use for tracking and charting metrics the box score does not carry. Next Gen Stats (2016+): time to throw, air yards, completion percentage above expectation, separation, cushion, rush yards over expected. Pro Football Reference advanced (2018+): pressures, hurries, blitzes, drops, bad throws, misse

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Use for betting lines. Pass game_id for one game (10 credits): the consensus closing spread and total (every game since 1999; moneyline every game since 2010) plus each sportsbook's closing line from the 2014 season (4-9 books for 2014-2019, closing only) and per-bookmaker opening, closing and lates

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Use to see how a game's lines moved: the full time series of hourly snapshots grouped by bookmaker. Most expensive tool (25 cr); use get_odds (10 cr) if you only need opening, closing, or current lines.

tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Use for player prop lines by sportsbook: over/under on passing yards, passing TDs, rushing yards, receiving yards and receptions, plus anytime TD, from the 2023 season (7 books: DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, ESPN BET, Pinnacle, Bovada, BetOnline). tools.description: Use for alternate spreads and totals by sportsbook: every point on each book's ladder with its price (e.g. KC -10.5 at +260, over 51.5 at +140), for one game, from the 2023 to 2025 seasons (6 books: FanDuel, DraftKings, BetMGM, Bovada, Pinnacle, ESPN BET). findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_plays" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use for play-by-play with nflfastR metrics: EPA, WPA, win probability, success, CPOE, air yards, formation flags, and the players involved. Filter by game, or by season plus week/team/player, plus play type, down, quarter, win-probability band, red zone, third down. Set include_charting for FTN manu" → after: "Use for play-by-play with nflfastR metrics: EPA, WPA, win probability, success, CPOE, air yards, formation flags, and the players involved. Filter by game, or by season plus week/team/player, plus play type, down, quarter, win-probability band, red zone, third down. Set include_charting for FTN manu"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan

evidence.snippet: before: "Use for a game's betting lines: consensus closing spread/total/moneylines for every game since 1999, plus per-bookmaker opening, closing, and latest moneyline, spread, and total (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, ESPN BET) for games from the 2026 season. Costs 10 credits." → after: "Use for betting lines. Pass game_id for one game (10 credits): the consensus closing spread and total (every game since 1999; moneyline every game since 2010) plus each sportsbook's closing line from the 2014 season (4-9 books for 2014-2019, closing only) and per-bookmaker opening, closing and lates"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
